title: Unintended Release of Information Regarding Three-year Lock-in Period for New Vehicles Bought for Private-hire Purposes
what_it_is: Unintended Release of Information Regarding Three-year Lock-in Period for New Vehicles Bought for Private-hire Purposes

sections.label: Lock-in period announcement brought forward
sections.summary: LTA brought forward its lock-in period policy announcement after vendor NCS prematurely revealed the message to some users on 18 February.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: LTA had originally planned to announce this policy change during the Ministry of Transport's (MOT’s) Committee of Supply (COS) debate in March 2025, as part of an update on our review of the point-to-point transport sector.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: However, LTA had to bring forward the implementation date due to an unintentional error by its system vendor NCS.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The team from NCS, who was working on the IT system changes, made a deployment error, resulting in the message regarding the lock-in period being prematurely revealed to some users before the planned announcement date.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: When MOT and LTA found out on 18 February that the information was prematurely revealed to some users, we decided to make a public announcement on the policy change on 19 February morning.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: This was because there was an ongoing Certificate of Entitlement (COE) bidding exercise from 17 February to 19 February, and we wanted to ensure fairness and transparency to all parties and allow bidders sufficient time to decide whether to adjust their bids, before the bidding cycle closed at 4.00 pm on 19 February.

sections.label: NCS error and preventive steps
sections.summary: NCS acknowledged responsibility for the deployment error and took steps, including a buddy system with a senior developer, to prevent recurrence.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: NCS had acknowledged and taken responsibility for the error.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The lines of code for program to control when this lock-in period message will be displayed and to which users, were actually not deployed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: When this error was discovered, NCS has taken various steps to prevent the recurrence of this error.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: They have also put in place a buddy system with a senior developer to check on the works or to review the works that were done.
